about.text: AVR Research and Development Pvt. Ltd. is an innovation-driven technology company established in 2021, committed to delivering advanced, reliable, and intelligent technological solutions. We specialize in real-time project development, software engineering, website design and development, hardware development, Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, and research-oriented technical services.

Our company focuses on transforming innovative ideas into practical, efficient, and scalable solutions that address real-world challenges. We combine technical expertise, creativity, and research-driven methodologies to develop customized solutions for students, academic institutions, researchers, startups, and businesses.

At AVR Research and Development Pvt. Ltd., we believe that technology and innovation are the driving forces behind a smarter future. Our mission is to bridge the gap between ideas and implementation through quality development, continuous research, and emerging technologies.
We are dedicated to building long-term relationships with our clients by delivering excellence, maintaining professional standards, and providing technology solutions that create meaningful impact.
Real-time applications, custom software and innovative project development
Responsive, user-friendly and professional websites for businesses and institutions
Embedded systems, smart devices, sensors, automation and IoT-based solutions
Technical research, AI & ML projects, innovative prototypes and research-oriented development

faq.question: What does AVR offer?
faq.answer: Our current offerings are listed under Services, Products and Portfolio. Programmes for students are under Projects, Training, Internships, Workshops and Research.

faq.question: How can I get in touch?
faq.answer: Call 7997129566, email avr@avrreasearchanddevelopment.com, or use the contact form. Our hours are Mon – Sat, 9:30 AM to 7:00 PM.

faq.question: Where are you located?
faq.answer: F5, Ruby Apartments, Opp Maitri Vanam, Pillar No-1464, Hyderabad.

faq.question: How do students enrol?
faq.answer: Open the Contact page (or press the Enquire button on any project or programme), tell us which project or programme you want, and our team will contact you.

faq.question: How do clients get started?
faq.answer: Send us a message through the Contact page and we will get back to you.

faq.question: What happens after I send a message?
faq.answer: Your message reaches our team directly. Include your email address and, if you like, a phone number so we can reach you.
